description: This file implements a class for managing audio/video input sources, including HDMI and composite inputs, handling hotplug events, video mode updates, and providing various RPC methods for control and status queries within a plugin architecture.

classes.name: AVInput
classes.description: A plugin class managing AV input sources, handling events like hotplug, signal change, video mode updates, and exposing RPC interfaces for control and info retrieval.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes plugin, registers event handlers and RPC methods.

methods.name: deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up plugin, unregisters event handlers.

methods.name: endpoint_numberOfInputs
methods.description: RPC endpoint to get count of inputs.

methods.name: endpoint_currentVideoMode
methods.description: RPC endpoint to get current video mode.

methods.name: startInput
methods.description: Starts input on a specified port with given type (HDMI or COMPOSITE).

methods.name: setVideoRectangleWrapper
methods.description: Sets video rectangle for input display.

methods.name: getInputDevices
methods.description: Retrieves list of input devices for a given type.

methods.name: writeEDID
methods.description: Writes EDID message to a port.

methods.name: readEDID
methods.description: Reads EDID from a port and returns it encoded.

methods.name: getSPD
methods.description: Retrieves SPD info for a port.

methods.name: setEdid2AllmSupportWrapper
methods.description: Enables/disables ALLM support in EDID for a port.

methods.name: getEdid2AllmSupportWrapper
methods.description: Gets ALLM support status for a port.

methods.name: setEdidVersion
methods.description: Sets EDID version for a port.

methods.name: getEdidVersion
methods.description: Gets EDID version for a port.
